title: CI runs and enforces everything that already exists
description: CI today runs only cargo test (without the wasm crate), tsc, a subset of the web tests and a Gherkin vocabulary check. This epic makes CI build the wasm, run every test suite in the repo (wasm, plans, Cucumber conformance, pytest) and enforce rustfmt, clippy, ruff and mypy. Done when every child is closed and a change cannot reach develop without all of them green.
